source: v1 sem o aviso gravado na tela.
description_pt: Vertical 9:16, só o produto, sem pessoas, sem fala, três cenas, ~15 s finais.

scenes.title: Apresentação
scenes.objective: Mostrar o produto inteiro e estabelecer cenário e luz, que servem de referência para as cenas seguintes.
scenes.framing: Produto inteiro em três quartos, apoiado na superfície, ocupando ~2/3 da altura útil.
scenes.motion: Câmera faz um arco lento de ~15° ao redor do produto parado.
scenes.image_prompt:
Create a vertical 9:16 photograph to be used as the first frame of a product video.

REFERENCES: the official product photos exclusively define the product.

$product_block

$environment
$lighting

$hands

COMPOSITION: product closed and fully inside the frame, standing on the surface, seen in three-quarter view, filling about two thirds of the usable height, with room around it for a slow camera move.

Still image. $camera
$negative Do not beautify or modify the product.
scenes.animation_prompt:
Animate the attached image into a vertical 9:16 video. Preserve exactly the setting, light and product of the starting frame.

The product stays completely still. The camera makes a slow, smooth arc of about 15 degrees around it, keeping the whole product visible, then holds briefly.

The product never moves, deforms or changes shape, color, lid or handle. No people, hands, new objects, speech, narration, music or on-screen text. Silent.
approval_criteria: Cor, variante, forma e proporções iguais às fotos oficiais
Tampa, alça, acabamento, acessórios e inscrições corretos
Cenário conforme a direção escolhida, sem textos ou logos inventados

scenes.title: Detalhes
scenes.objective: Plano próximo destacando os detalhes visíveis do produto.
scenes.motion: Aproximação muito lenta da câmera sobre o detalhe.
scenes.image_prompt:
Create a second vertical 9:16 photograph from the same session, using the scene-1 image as the continuity reference and the official photos for product fidelity.

Preserve exactly the same product, setting, surface and light direction.

Closer shot from a slightly higher angle, highlighting the visible details (lid, rim, handle, finish) exactly as they appear in the references.

$product_block

$hands

Sharp product, natural reflections. Do not invent mechanisms, inscriptions or accessories. $camera
$negative
scenes.animation_prompt:
Animate this photograph into a vertical 9:16 video. The product stays still. The camera pushes in very slowly and smoothly on the detail, with stable focus.

The product never moves, deforms or changes. No people, hands, liquids, steam, new objects, speech, music or text. Silent.
approval_criteria: Mesmo produto e variante da cena 1 e das fotos oficiais

scenes.title: Fechamento
scenes.objective: Plano final limpo do produto, adequado para capa.
scenes.framing: Produto inteiro, centralizado, com folga ao redor.
scenes.motion: Câmera se afasta lentamente; pausa final no produto.
scenes.image_prompt:
Create the third vertical 9:16 photograph of the same product session. Use the scene-1 image as the reference for setting, light and color; the official photos define the exact product.

The product is closed, whole and centered on the same surface, with generous space around it.

$product_block

$environment
$lighting

$hands

$camera
$negative
scenes.animation_prompt:
Animate the starting image into a vertical 9:16 video. The product stays still. The camera pulls back very slowly, keeping the whole product visible, and ends with a brief pause.

The product must not move, float or change size. Do not crop the lid or the base. No people, hands, speech, music, text or new objects. Silent.
approval_criteria: Enquadramento final limpo, adequado para capa
